eligibility.quote: I've found the issue. Actually the default ROS2 humble DDS is fine. I forgot that I had specific DDS setting in my `~/.bashrc` (`FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE`) ... By removing that specific config and by re-running the test above, I have now similar results than with ROS1

notes: Issue #727 body (reproducer with lookup 'would require extrapolation into the future' logs and 'for almost 3 seconds of TF waiting, the TF Buffer didn't get updated once') and matlabbe's resolution comment 2481510627 verified verbatim; the reporter also withdrew the per-RMW comparison ('I didn't re-rerun the test on all other DDS, maybe that config also affected their results'). The ineligibility decision is correct: the minimal resolving change is removing a user-local middleware profile (FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE in ~/.bashrc), with no change to any unit's declared or referenced interface, and the source never states what the profile contained or which mechanism caused the delay. reason_code 'deployment_wiring' is a loose fit (the spec's notes transparently flag that step 3 is worded for name binding and that 'internal' at step 2 is the alternative reading); either way the case is ineligible. failed_conditions/loudness/resolution are correctly absent (null in the spec).
